description: This file is a shell script that invokes Tcl code to provide a GUI prompt for SSH passphrase entry, specifically for use with Git-GUI as an SSH_ASKPASS handler.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Sets the return code to 255, indicating cancellation.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Validates input, encodes if on Windows, prints the answer, and sets return code 0 for success.
